seg.notes: Bridge from release text (Freight: acquisitions '$1.3 billion', organic -$22m, FX -$2m; Transit: organic +$19m, acquisitions $2m, FX -$16m). Freight acquisitions recorded as 1269.5 = Q4-19 Freight sales 1667.1 - recast Q4-18 Freight sales 421.6 + 22 + 2 (computed residual; published only as $1.3bn); totals summed. corp_op computed as total op income - segments (Q4 three-month corporate not published). frt_gp/trn_gp from Q4-19 release Appendix G/H. items.other_label: restructuring = combined 'Restructuring/Transaction (and Litigation) costs' row as published (transaction not split out, so transaction=null); inventory_pa = 'One-time PPA' (non-cash GE Transportation inventory step-up); other_op = non-cash accounting 'Policy Harmonization' (GE Transportation accounting-policy harmonization; also adjusts net sales/GP); nonop = merger-related interest/financing costs in the 'Interest & Other Exp' column of the restructuring/transaction row; discrete_tax = 'Tax on Transaction Costs' (non-deductible transaction costs).

ngaap.guidance: 2020 guidance (Feb-18-2020): GAAP sales ~$8.7bn; GAAP op income ~$1.1bn; GAAP diluted EPS $3.20-$3.50; EBITDA ~$1.6bn; adjusted op income ~$1.4bn; adjusted EBITDA ~$1.6bn; adjusted EPS $4.50-$4.80 (adjusted guidance now excludes recurring purchase price accounting amortization); adjusted op margin ~16%; adjusted ETR ~25.5%; net synergy benefit >$150m in 2020; GAAP CFO ~$900m incl. ~$100m outflows for prior-year restructuring and litigation; Q1-20 expected seasonally lower.
ngaap.notes: 2019 'adjusted' definition (as originally reported): excludes GE Transportation merger costs - transaction & restructuring (and, from Q3, litigation) costs, one-time non-cash purchase price accounting (inventory step-up) charges, non-cash accounting policy harmonization, related merger financing interest and tax on non-deductible transaction costs. Recurring PPA amortization was NOT added back in 2019. EBITDA (2019 definition) = income from operations + depreciation + amortization (other income excluded, so ebitda_other=null); ebitda_dda = depreciation + amortization columns summed. From Q1-20 Wabtec redefined adjusted results (adds back all non-cash intangible amortization and FX losses; drops policy harmonization and one-time PPA in adjusted sales/GP) and EBITDA (= op income + other income + D&A). Q4-19 adjusted results INCLUDE +$15.6m non-cash policy harmonization. Recurring PPA after-tax $0.26/sh not added back. Recast in Q3-20/Q4-20 releases under 2020 definition: Q4-19 adjusted op income 362.6, adjusted EPS $1.23; 2020-definition EBITDA 343.8, adjusted EBITDA 414.8.
